annotations.title: Compare two US stocks, or a stock and an ETF

description: Two US stocks: market cap, valuation, returns, the covered US ETFs holding both, and with three years of prices their worst fall, volatility, beta and the correlation of their weekly returns. A fund ticker works on one side and returns whether the fund holds the stock, at what weight and rank.

a.description: A US stock ticker, for example NVDA. An ETF ticker also works.
